first_prototype_scope: S0 one track module, then S1 two fixed tracks with Pi/OpenCR, LiDAR, camera and audio. Preserve modules for later flippers; stairs are a later qualification goal.
whole_system_release_requirements: H01-H10 plus assembly commissioning gates G1-G7; proposed circuit and sensor mounts are not released
selection_status: S1 fixed tracks first. Compare budget DIY joints, integrated brushless joints and aspirational high-end Dynamixels, with reduced XL430/gearmotor alternatives retained. Evaluate two- and four-pitch layouts toward four tracked legs with pitch and lateral movement. No joint or future layout selected; complete fit, power and cost precede selection.
